g.text: Steel and plastic have similar casualty-report rates

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5e6d76

g.text: The same period, component scope and matched material mileage are used in every term.

g.text: Plastic has fewer reports per mile-year and a higher casualty share among reports. The resulting point estimates are similar.

g.text: This figure shows the arithmetic identity in one cohort. Rate intervals are shown in the material comparison.
